instruction: Choose exactly one allowed action. Use only supplied observations and knowledge. Do not calculate or set emotion.

attributions.cause: The active squad eliminated the enemy squad before losing any member, producing the observed win.
alternativeCauses: The encounter may have posed a low enough physical threat that the starting squad composition was not decisive.
attributions.nextTest: Equip the obtained gear and compare survival and completion against the next available main encounter.

attributions.cause: Equipping the common gloves on the warrior increased equipped power from 0 to 32.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and observe whether the equipped warrior retains strong combat contribution.

attributions.cause: Equipping the common charm on the healer increased total equipped power from 32 to 52.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge the next main encounter and observe healer contribution and squad survival.

attributions.cause: The cleared encounter produced a character unlock for the mage.
Equipping the item increased the hero's power from 52 to 87, a gain of 35.
attributions.nextTest: Equip a different item and check whether the observed power changes by its reported power delta.

attributions.cause: The player explicitly replaced the Spear Militia with the newly unlocked Mage, changing the active team while equipped power stayed at 87.
attributions.nextTest: Use the changed team in Main 3 and compare the Mage's visible contribution.

attributions.cause: Explicitly equipping the Main 2 weapon on the Warrior increased equipped power by 28.
attributions.nextTest: Challenge Main 3 with the equipped weapon and changed team.

attributions.cause: After the player manually selected the Mage, the Mage dealt 62.04% of team damage and ranked first in Main 3, confirming the team-change hypothesis.
alternativeCauses: The newly equipped Warrior weapon also contributed to the overall win.
attributions.nextTest: Keep the Mage active for the next mixed encounter and compare whether its damage lead persists.

attributions.cause: Equipping the Lv.7 chest on the Barricade Militia raised equipped power from 115 to 149.
attributions.nextTest: Finish preparing the active squad, then attempt the visible Prison rescue.

attributions.cause: Equipping the Lv.4 boots on the Warrior increased equipped power from 149 to 175.
attributions.nextTest: Attempt the visible Prison rescue with the fully prepared inventory.

attributions.cause: The prepared squad failed the Prison because it was eliminated while two enemies remained; the first rescue hypothesis is refuted at equipped power 175.
alternativeCauses: The surviving ranged enemy and healer may be a specific threat pattern rather than only a total-power shortage.
attributions.nextTest: Continue the available mainline to obtain a visible power or equipment change before retrying the Prison.
